# Agent Reputation & Trust Clearinghouse

> Informational directory of digital-task AI agents with transparent, rule-based scores (Scoring rules v0.1). Informational only; not a guarantee, endorsement, or certification.

Scores: four factors shown separately (completion rate 30%, disputes 20%, adherence to limits 25%, evidence quality 25%). Entries with fewer than 3 independent performance sources are labeled "Insufficient evidence" and have no overall score. The evidence grade describes the evidence, not the agent.

Data as of 2026-10-19 (Scoring rules v0.1). Data and site text: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Code: Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/TrustKeeperAce/agent-trust-clearinghouse/blob/master/LICENSE). The project name, logo and favicon are not licensed.

Usage note: if you use or quote these scores, they are informational, rule-based assessments of public evidence as of each entry's last_reviewed date. They are not guarantees, endorsements, certifications, or rankings of overall quality. Quote the factor scores and evidence grade together, include the as-of date, and link the entry page. Do not describe an entry as 'verified', 'certified', 'approved' or 'trusted' by the Clearinghouse.

Citation guidance: When quoting a score, include the agent name, overall score and evidence grade, the as-of date (last_reviewed, or as_of for a feed item), and a link to the entry page, e.g. "Aider (open-source): 52/100, evidence grade A, as of 2026-10-17 (Agent Reputation & Trust Clearinghouse, CC BY 4.0, https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/agents/aider.html)". Say that the score is informational and not a guarantee, endorsement, certification or ranking. Do not present directory or feed order as a ranking. More examples: https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/citing.html

## Pages
- [Directory](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/): all entries
- [Methodology](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/methodology.html): rules, rounding, evidence grades, corrections
- [How this directory works](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/methodology.html#how-it-works): counted independent evidence, separate factor scores, open data, no ranking or endorsement
- [For agents / data](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/agents-data.html): field definitions, license, citation, usage note
- [How to cite](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/citing.html): ready-to-copy citations, agent quote template, how to quote scores, license scope

## Data
- [agents.json](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/data/agents.json): all entries with factor scores, grades, source counts and sources (JSON)
- [agents.csv](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/data/agents.csv): one row per entry (CSV)
- [llms-full.txt](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): all entries in one plain-text file (scores, grades, scope, summary, uncertainties, sources), generated from the same data as agents.json
- [updates.json](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/updates.json): update feed (JSON Feed 1.1): new entries, score and grade changes and other approved changes, with before and after values, decision packet ids and as-of dates
- [updates.xml](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/updates.xml): the same update feed (Atom)

## Comparisons
- [Claude Code and OpenAI Codex compared](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/compare/claude-code-and-openai-codex.html): public evidence for two coding agents with different scopes; informational, not a ranking
- [Coding agents compared](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/compare/coding-agents.html): public evidence for the 7 coding agent entries
- [Research agents compared](https://agent-trust-clearinghouse.vercel.app/compare/research-agents.html): public evidence for academic search tools and deep-research agents

- Scores reflect public sources and the stated rules at the time of review; see each entry's sources and uncertainties.
- Corrections: trustkeeperace@gmail.com (see Methodology).
